categories_thin: Med spas / aesthetics: only one confirmed inside the zone (Renatus Aesthetics, which does now have a live site and phone). Other results were in Plainsboro, Princeton, North Brunswick or East Brunswick.

Mental health / counseling: Ellie Mental Health and Lifebulb are franchise/telehealth brands (excluded); remaining in-zone listings are solo therapists at residential addresses. Only one group practice confirmed (Awakened Path, 878 Georges Rd).

Dental specialists (endodontics, periodontics, oral surgery, pediatric dentistry): searched again and found none with a South Brunswick street address - in-zone practices handled those services in-house, and the standalone specialists surfaced were in East Brunswick, North Brunswick or Princeton.

Dermatology, OB/GYN, ENT, cardiology, orthopedics and pain management: nearly all local results are large health-system practices (Penn Medicine, Hackensack Meridian, RWJBarnabas, Lifeline/RWJ) which the brief excludes. The one gynecology entry previously listed was removed for this reason.

Audiologists / hearing aids: searched again - no audiology practice with a South Brunswick address. Nearby practices are in Monroe, Cranbury, Somerset and East Brunswick; the only in-zone hit (a hearing-aid parts/repair shop on Cornwall Rd) is a repair business found in a blocked directory only.

Pet grooming/boarding: apart from All Good Dogs there is one storefront groomer (Pretty Paws-NJ) that appears only in a blocked Yellow Pages list; most other groomers found are mobile businesses based outside the zone.
Physical therapy and chiropractic remain the deepest health categories; optometry improved from two to four entries after the re-search.
caveats: Google Maps and Bing Maps returned only 4-7 local results per query in this environment (limited anonymous view), so map coverage is a sample rather than a full enumeration.

Yellow Pages, Superpages, unilocal, BBB, Manta, salondiscover, LocalityBiz and several other bulk directories returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks even in a real browser, so businesses that appear only there are flagged 'one bulk directory only'.
The Overpass / OpenStreetMap API was unreachable from this environment; no OSM extract was used.

Two websites from the earlier pass were removed for being dead or unrelated (an eyewear-shop domain that does not resolve, and a chiropractic domain that does not resolve); one was corrected to the live All Good Dogs domain after the 404. No website is now recorded unless it was opened or seen linked from an opened listing.
Several entries are directory-only and are flagged in active_evidence; the triage team should confirm they still operate before outreach.

Solo practitioners working from residential addresses were deliberately excluded to stay within business-contact-only rules. The real count of independent health/wellness practices in the zone is higher than listed.

Franchise and chain locations were excluded, including MassageLuXe Kendall Park, Hair Cuttery Dayton, Supercuts Monmouth Junction, The Smilist Dental Dayton, Twin Boro Physical Therapy, The MAX Challenge / MAX Fitness & Wellness Center South Brunswick, Ellie Mental Health, Lifebulb Counseling, Club Pilates, F45 and Crunch.
Nearly all addresses in this zone fall within 10 miles of central Milltown; no part of South Brunswick falls outside the radius.

Entries for a multi-state operator branch (a detox/treatment center on US-1) and for a health-system gynecology practice were dropped in this revision, as was a stale duplicate of a renamed pediatric practice.
data_gaps: No official South Brunswick Township business directory or licensed-business list was retrievable; the township site has no public business directory found.
